senses.gloss: ) Onyx Agate, a semipellucid stone of a fine flinty texture.
a variety of gypseous alabaster, onyx; a glaze. Ib. 11ᵇ ומחפין … בא׳ Ar. (ed. באי׳) the streets are paved with &c. (for the procession).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 1:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. I, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02244"><he>אָנַךְ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33:2">Lev. R. s. 33</cite> nothing makes the kettle durable <he>אלא אֲנָכָהּ וכ׳</he> but its glaze lining; so says the Lord <he>אֲנָכְכֶם וכ׳</he> I am your lining (stay) in trials (incorr. in some ed. a. Ar. s. v. <he>נך</he>).
